questions.topic: Two accounts of how the union grew
questions.learningObjective: Synthesise a balanced growth narrative

stimulus.body: Growth is sometimes told as a story of adding members. Other times it is told as deepening cooperation. The truth includes both, plus the tension between them. Neither story alone suffices.

questions.stem: Translator note 59 quotes an excerpt on growth narratives; what is the conclusion?
questions.explanation: Both widening and deepening matter, along with the tension between them. Neither alone suffices.
